user.title: Connect to the Urmet gateway add-on
user.description: Enter the host and port of the urmet-gateway add-on. The default host is the Supervisor bridge gateway.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the Urmet gateway connection
reconfigure.description: Update the host and port. The doorphone must be the same panel as before.

confirm.title: Set up the Urmet doorphone
confirm.description: The urmet-gateway add-on was found at {host}. Confirm to add the doorphone. If it reports that no panel is known yet, ring the doorphone once or set doorphone_mac in the add-on options, then confirm again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the gateway add-on at that host and port.
error.no_doorphone: The gateway does not know any panel yet. Set doorphone_mac in the add-on options, or wait for the first ring, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This doorphone is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That gateway serves a different panel than this entry. Reconfigure was cancelled.

data.show_tech_panel: Show the technical panel on the card

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Answer the ringing call. Answers the named dialog, or the only ringing dialog if there is one.

call_id.name: Call id
call_id.description: The dialog to answer. Leave empty to answer the only ringing call.

hang_up.name: Hang up
hang_up.description: Hang up a call. Ends the named dialog, or the live dialog if there is one.

call_id.name: Call id
call_id.description: The dialog to hang up. Leave empty to hang up the live call.

look.name: Look at the door
look.description: Place an on-demand call to the panel and return its id. The gateway releases it automatically if no media session attaches.

want_video.name: Request video
want_video.description: Ask the panel for a picture as well as sound.

open.name: Open
open.description: Fire the door or the gate. Returns whether the panel acknowledged; an unacknowledged open means the outcome is unknown, never that the door opened.

set_microphone.name: Set microphone
set_microphone.description: Mute or unmute the microphone towards the panel.

muted.name: Muted
muted.description: True mutes the microphone, false opens it.

unconfirmed_release.title: SIP binding not released
unconfirmed_release.description: The doorphone gateway could not confirm that its SIP binding was released. The doorbell may be degraded for up to 15 minutes while the old binding expires, then it recovers on its own.

auth_failure.title: Doorphone cloud sign-in rejected
auth_failure.description: The Urmet cloud rejected the credentials the gateway registers with (a 401 or 403 response). Update the email and password in the urmet-gateway add-on options and restart the add-on. These credentials live in the add-on, not in Home Assistant, so there is no reconfigure flow here.

calls_not_routed.title: Calls refused before routing
calls_not_routed.description: Registration is healthy but every call is refused with a 503 before it is routed. Check that no outbound proxy or Route header was introduced between the gateway and the Urmet cloud, then run this repair to reload the integration.

confirm.title: Reload the doorphone integration
confirm.description: This reloads the integration, which re-reads the gateway configuration. Confirm once you have checked that no outbound proxy or Route header remains.
